summary: Milestone's official Monster Energy Supercross series, focused on licensed stadium supercross tracks, riders, careers, editors, and annual physics and roster revisions.

entries.title: Monster Energy Supercross: The Official Videogame

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows version as primary; console/Switch emulation is only for preservation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC route exceeds original console/portable fidelity

primary.why: The first Monster Energy Supercross game released on Windows, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and Nintendo Switch. It featured the 2017 schedule, locale and riders, career, track editor, rewind, and 250cc/450cc career racing; Windows is the highest-fidelity configurable route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings; use PS4 or Xbox One as console alternatives and Switch only for portable preservation.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster or complete edition.

primary.why: Monster Energy Supercross 25 released for Windows PC via Steam and Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S, leaving previous-generation consoles behind. It uses Unreal Engine 5, current-season track blueprints, updated physics, neural AI, and 2025 championship rosters/tracks; PC is the highest-fidelity configurable route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version from Steam or Epic Games Store at the highest stable settings; use PS5 or Xbox Series X/S as strong console alternatives.

entries.remaster_caveats: Some aggregate pages conflict with contemporary release reporting on legacy-console/Switch availability; verify storefronts again if preserving every late port.
